name: DTC Protect Instruction Status 1 Code
definition: DTC (The Depository Trust Company) system status code of protect instruction.

PENA.name: Pending Approval
PENA.definition: Instruction pending release or delete from approval function.

WITH.name: Withdrawn
WITH.definition: Client instruction withdrawn for events with withdrawal privilege.

COVR.name: Fully Covered
COVR.definition: Protect instruction has been fully covered.

OPEN.name: Open
OPEN.definition: Protect instruction which has not been fully covered. Will include partial covers.
